title: Broadcom VMware ESX: security flaw used in attacks
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 100 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: Servers and backups
category.why: It runs or protects many systems at once, including your backups.
category.doThis: Patch it and keep its admin access off the internet.

summary: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. CISA set Nov 11, 2026 as the deadline for US federal agencies. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
